claim: Amazon ECS Express Mode services support either public or private HTTPS applications and automatically scale based on utilization or traffic; one scenario for using them is web applications and APIs, which are stateless containerized applications that serve HTTP requests.

evidence.quote: Use Amazon ECS Express Mode services in the following scenarios:
Web applications and APIs - Stateless containerized applications that serve HTTP requests
Amazon ECS Express Mode services support either public or private HTTPS applications and automatically scale based on utilization or traffic.
